children: Vietnam's State Treasury raised 14.65 trillion dong ($564 million) in its weekly government bond auction on Wednesday, slightly down from $578 million raised last week, according to a Hanoi Stock Exchange filing.
Vietnam had offered 26 trillion dong worth of bonds for auction this week, the biggest amount so far this year as it looks to accelerate sales to meet a fundraising target of 500 trillion dong.
The treasury sold 6.85 trillion dong out of the 15 trillion dong of 10-year bonds on offer, at a coupon of 4.43%.
It sold 7.8 trillion dong out of the 9 trillion dong of 5-year bonds on offer, at a coupon of 4.27%.
It failed to offload any of the combined 2 trillion dong of 3-, 15- and 30-year bonds on offer.
Reuters reported on Wednesday that the government was considering its first sovereign dollar bond sale in more than a decade, and is in talks with investment banks about possible terms.
Vietnamese companies have raised 387 trillion dong via bonds this year up to September 11, according to bond market association data.
The total value of corporate bonds maturing during the remainder of this year is 81 trillion dong.
